console_logs: (server log) WARN webhook event evt_a91f processed twice
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the payment provider webhook
evaluated_records.root_cause: The webhook endpoint has no idempotency check, and the provider retries delivery after a slow response.
evaluated_records.resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

evaluated_records.bug_description: Session stays valid on the server after I click Log out. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Account page still visible after logging out.

steps_to_reproduce: Replay a request with the old session cookie or press Back on https://shop.example.com/logout
Observe private data is still returned
evaluated_records.root_cause: Logout only clears the client cookie; the server session is not destroyed.
evaluated_records.resolution: Invalidate the session/token on the server at logout and send no-store cache headers.

evaluated_records.bug_description: Hi team, date picker shows MM/DD/YYYY instead of the local format (ja-JP).

screenshot.description: Date picker displaying 10/12/2025 while the account locale is ja-JP.

steps_to_reproduce: Set the account language/region to ja-JP
evaluated_records.root_cause: The locale prop is not passed from user settings so the component falls back to en-US.
evaluated_records.resolution: Pass the user's locale to the DatePicker and add the matching locale data.

evaluated_records.bug_description: Urgent: Random logout / 401 errors when several widgets load at the same time. Please fix ASAP.
